subject: Fixes to dual certs (#4663)
reason: The only server-code change (src/tls.c) adds the alternate dual-cert key file to the TLS auto-reload change-detection metadata (tlsMaterialsMetadata, captureMetadata, metadataChanged), so a periodic background reload now notices when only the alt key file changed on disk. This path (metadataChanged) is reached solely from the background tls-auto-reload-interval timer, never from CONFIG SET.
